# coderforge_container_networks (Data Source)

Swarm overlay networks the platform tracks. Their `rid` is what `coderforge_container_service.network_rid` expects, which is how two services are put on the same network.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Return only the network with this exact name.

### Read-Only

- `networks` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--networks))

<a id="nestedatt--networks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `networks`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String)
- `driver` (String)
- `id` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `rid` (String) Resource id, e.g. `cs_net:0001`.
